Χαρώνιος.s: of, belonging to Charon, through which criminals were led to execution, caverns filled with mephitic vapours
b: of or belonging to Charon: hence,
the gate through which criminals were led to execution,
a staircase in the theatre, leading up to the stage as if from the underworld, by which ghosts entered,
caverns filled with mephitic vapours, being looked on as entrances to the nether world,

Χαρωνῖται.s: Orcini, Senators from the nether world
b: Orcini, Senators from the nether world, viz. those who were created after the death of Caesar, professedly on the authority of papers left behind by him,
keep gaping at or after him,

χάσκω.s: yawn, gape, may, yawn, opening the mouth wide

then may earth yawn for me, i.e. to swallow me,
